title: Summit Tier Qualification and Validity Schedule
content:
The Crestline Summit Loyalty Program has six tiers. For each tier this schedule sets the qualifying dollars that earn it within one calendar year, when an earned tier stops being valid, how far a member can fall at one annual requalification, and whether the tier can be obtained provisionally by a status challenge.

## Qualification and validity

| Tier | Qualifying dollars earned in one calendar year (USD) | Validity ends on the last day of calendar month | Validity ends in the year this many years after the qualification year | Most tiers a member can fall at one annual requalification |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Member | 0 | 1 (January) | 2 | 1 |
| Summit Silver | 4500 | 1 (January) | 2 | 1 |
| Summit Gold | 9000 | 1 (January) | 2 | 1 |
| Summit Platinum | 14000 | 1 (January) | 2 | 1 |
| Summit Diamond | 26000 | 1 (January) | 2 | 1 |
| Summit Chairman | 40000 | 1 (January) | 2 | 1 |

Every tier is open only to individual customers. Summit Chairman is entered only by invitation; its qualifying-dollar figure is never enough on its own. No other tier requires an invitation.

## Status challenge

| Tier | Offered by status challenge | Qualifying dollars that must be earned inside the challenge period (USD) | Challenge period, calendar days from the day the challenge is granted |
|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Member | No | 0 | 0 |
| Summit Silver | Yes | 1500 | 90 |
| Summit Gold | Yes | 3000 | 90 |
| Summit Platinum | Yes | 4500 | 90 |
| Summit Diamond | No | 0 | 0 |
| Summit Chairman | No | 0 | 0 |

## Reading the schedule

- **Validity date.** The two validity columns together give the last valid day: the last day of January in the second calendar year after the qualification year. Hypothetical illustration: a tier earned in qualification year 2025 is valid through 31 January 2027.
- **Status challenge.** Only Summit Silver, Summit Gold and Summit Platinum are offered by challenge; for Summit Member, Summit Diamond and Summit Chairman the challenge columns carry no figure that applies.
- **Hypothetical illustration.** A member with 9000 USD of qualifying dollars in one calendar year has reached the Summit Gold figure but not the Summit Platinum figure of 14000 USD.
